review.tagline: MCP server and CLI that fetch current library docs into coding-agent prompts
review.summary: Context7 looks up version-specific documentation and code examples for a library and places them in the agent's context. It runs as an MCP server (tools resolve-library-id and query-docs) or as a ctx7 CLI plus a skill, with no MCP needed. The repo holds the MCP server, CLI and SDKs; the API backend, parsing and crawling engines are private.
review.audience: Developers using coding agents who want current library docs in prompts
strengths: Two modes: MCP server tools, or ctx7 CLI with an installed skill
One command, npx ctx7 setup, configures Cursor, Claude Code or OpenCode
Version-aware lookups; prompts can pin a library ID such as /vercel/next.js
Also ships a TypeScript SDK and Vercel AI SDK tools
weaknesses: API backend, parser and crawler are private; only client code is open
Depends on the hosted service at mcp.context7.com; local run is a separate guide
API key recommended for higher rate limits; the limits are not stated
Indexed docs are community-contributed; README gives no accuracy guarantee
needs: Needs Context7 hosted API (mcp.context7.com), Node.js 22.13+ for ctx7 CLI
